notes: We have not checked Daewoo's reset steps against a U.S. owner's manual yet, so no steps are listed here. Look in your owner's manual under the maintenance reminder and tire pressure monitoring sections for your exact year. Reset a service reminder only after the work is done. For a tire pressure light, set every tire to the cold pressure on the vehicle's tire label first. If that light flashes for about a minute at startup and then stays on, the system has a fault and needs checking.
